name: HC26b: Total Tested
description: Number of active ART clients who reached 6 months on ART during the reporting period and had a viral load test during the reporting period. Counts unique patients from the HC26a six-month eligibility cohort who had a viral load specimen collected during the reporting period.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* Reached 6 months on ART during reporting period */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* VL test evidence during reporting period */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v

              v.order_date
            ) >= :startDate

              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date

        /* Evidence that this represents an actual VL test */
        AND (
            v.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.is_valid_result = 1
        )
  )

            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* Reached 6 months on ART during reporting period */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* VL test evidence during reporting period */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) >= :startDate

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

        /* Evidence that this represents an actual VL test */
        AND (
            v.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.is_valid_result = 1
        )
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
